sql: select d.deployment_key, (d.config_json::jsonb ? 'material') as has_material, d.config_json::jsonb -> 'material' as material, (select count(*) from experiment_integrity_events e where e.deployment_id = d.id and e.kind = 'EXPERIMENT_CONFIG_UNVERIFIABLE' and e.resolved_at is null) as open_unverifiable from experiment_deployments d where d.kind = 'live' and d.ended_at is null order by d.started_at
